correctness.rationale: Classify enhanced diagrams of three stationary objects by sort, equality, incidences and special collinearity/concurrency. Three collinear anchors have q-2 unused points, so q2 is exceptional; three noncollinear anchors have q-1 side witnesses, (q-1)^2 points off all sides. For two points and a line, direct inclusion/exclusion using h=0/1/2 anchor incidences yields the RESULT.md support tables; duality handles line cases. Every support type is the same for all q≥3, giving a permanent four-pebble partial-isomorphism strategy independent of plane coordinatization. Three concurrent lines cover all seven Fano points, but not any q≥3 plane; FO3 cannot separate any planes, FO5 four-concurrent-line covering separates q3 from q≥4. Independent complete enhanced-diagram support census at q2 (14 objects) and q3 (26 objects) verified 48 three-anchor types each and different Fano-vs-nonFano support.
